name: tracker
description: Issue tracking from the editor. Reads, files, triages and comments on tracker issues, and manages the webhooks a bot subscribes itself to — over the workspace's MCP endpoint, authorized as its own member.

TRACKER_URL.title: tracker URL
TRACKER_URL.description: Origin of your tracker instance, with no trailing slash — the plugin appends /api/mcp. Defaults to the hosted one; point it at your own deployment, or at http://localhost:5173 for a local checkout.
